# Stardew Valley Planner

> A browser-based Stardew Valley farm-layout planner with English and Simplified Chinese guides for official farm maps, modded planning maps, and browser-local projects.

## English

Stardew Valley Planner helps you plan farm layouts in your browser. Projects stay in your browser and the site does not require an account or cloud sync.

### Planner and reference

- [Stardew Valley Planner](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art): Plan a Stardew Valley farm layout in your browser.
- [Farm types compared](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/farm-comparison): Compare the eight official farm maps before planning a layout.
- [Modded farms](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/mods): Browse local planning maps for community-made farms and interiors.
- [Privacy policy](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/privacy): Learn how browser-local projects and site data are handled.
- [Terms of service](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/terms): Read the browser-local terms, including optional JSON import and export and the fan-made status.

### Official farm guides

- [Standard Farm guide](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/farm/standard): Learn about the Standard Farm and start planning its layout.
- [Riverland Farm guide](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/farm/riverland): Learn about the Riverland Farm and start planning its layout.
- [Forest Farm guide](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/farm/forest): Learn about the Forest Farm and start planning its layout.
- [Hill-top Farm guide](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/farm/hilltop): Learn about the Hill-top Farm and start planning its layout.
- [Wilderness Farm guide](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/farm/wilderness): Learn about the Wilderness Farm and start planning its layout.
- [Four Corners Farm guide](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/farm/four-corners): Learn about the Four Corners Farm and start planning its layout.
- [Beach Farm guide](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/farm/beach): Learn about the Beach Farm and start planning its layout.
- [Meadowlands Farm guide](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/farm/meadowlands): Learn about the Meadowlands Farm and start planning its layout.

### Planning guides

- [Stardew Valley Planning Guides](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/blog): Browse practical guides for planning a clearer, more flexible farm.
- [Planning guide archive](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/blog/archive): Browse every Stardew Valley planning guide.
- [Carpenter in Stardew Valley](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/carpenter-stardew): Find Robin's shop hours, location, and building services before ordering a farm project.
- [Where Is Robin in Stardew Valley?](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/where-is-robin-stardew-valley): Find Robin's location, service hours, and the schedule conditions that can change her day.

## 简体中文

星露谷农场规划器可帮助你在浏览器中规划农场布局。项目保留在浏览器本地，不需要账户或云端同步。

### 规划器与参考内容

- [星露谷农场规划器](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh): 在浏览器中规划《星露谷物语》农场布局。
- [农场类型对比](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/farm-comparison): 在开始规划前，对比八种官方农场地图。
- [模组农场](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/mods): 规划你的星露谷模组组合。
- [隐私政策](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/privacy): 了解浏览器本地项目和站点数据的处理方式。
- [服务条款](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/terms): 阅读浏览器本地服务条款，包括可选 JSON 导入导出和同人创作说明。

### 官方农场指南

- [标准农场指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/farm/standard): 了解标准农场并开始规划布局。
- [河流农场指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/farm/riverland): 了解河流农场并开始规划布局。
- [森林农场指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/farm/forest): 了解森林农场并开始规划布局。
- [山顶农场指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/farm/hilltop): 了解山顶农场并开始规划布局。
- [荒野农场指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/farm/wilderness): 了解荒野农场并开始规划布局。
- [四角农场指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/farm/four-corners): 了解四角农场并开始规划布局。
- [海滩农场指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/farm/beach): 了解海滩农场并开始规划布局。
- [草原农场指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/farm/meadowlands): 了解草原农场并开始规划布局。

### 农场规划指南

- [星露谷农场规划指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/blog): 浏览帮助你更清晰、更灵活规划农场的实用指南。
- [规划指南归档](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/blog/archive): 浏览全部星露谷农场规划指南。
- [星露谷木匠指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/carpenter-stardew): 在安排农场建筑项目前，查看罗宾商店的营业时间、位置和建筑服务。
- [罗宾在星露谷物语的哪里](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/where-is-robin-stardew-valley): 查看罗宾的位置、服务时间，以及会改变她每日行程的条件。
